summary.title: Turn notes into a one-page brief
summary.prompt: Please turn the material I provide into a one-page summary as a collaborative document. If I have not shared material yet, ask for the topic first, then complete the brief from public info or what I add.

notice.title: Draft a formal notice
notice.prompt: Please draft a formal notice or announcement. Start with a clear structure, then produce an editable document I can publish.

outline.title: Write a project plan
outline.prompt: Please help me write a project plan. Ask for the goal and audience first, then produce a structured plan document.

minutes.title: Turn notes into minutes
minutes.prompt: Please turn the meeting notes I provide into formal minutes with conclusions, action items, and open questions.

create.title: Create a business table
create.prompt: Please design and create a multi-dimensional table. Propose fields for the scenario I describe; if I have not named one, default to a task tracker.
create.outcome: Get a table ready to use

task.title: Create a task tracker
task.prompt: Please create a task tracker with task, owner, status, priority, and due date fields, plus a few example rows.
task.outcome: Get a tracker ready for entries

customer.title: Create a customer tracker
customer.prompt: Please create a customer tracker with customer, contact, stage, last touch, and next step fields, and explain the structure.

plan.title: Turn a plan into a table
plan.prompt: Please turn the plan I describe into a table organized by item, timing, owner, and status. Leave unknown fields blank.
plan.outcome: Get a plan you can keep updating

research.title: Research and organize online
research.prompt: Please research a topic: confirm the topic if needed, gather public information online, and produce a document with key points and sources.

pricing.title: Check pricing and reviews
pricing.prompt: Please research a product's public pricing, main features, and user reviews, then organize the findings into a clear one-page document.

news.title: Collect recent coverage
news.prompt: Please collect recent public coverage about a topic, summarize each source's key information, and organize it into a document.

compare.title: Build a competitor comparison
compare.prompt: Please research the products or topic I specify and produce a competitor comparison with key differences, pros, cons, and sources.

summary.title: Turn notes into a one-page brief
summary.prompt: Please turn the material I provide into a one-page summary as a collaborative document. If I have not shared material yet, ask for the topic first, then complete the brief from public info or what I add.

createTable.title: Create a business table
createTable.prompt: Please design and create a multi-dimensional table. Propose fields for the scenario I describe; if I have not named one, default to a task tracker and offer adjustable fields.

webResearch.title: Research and organize online
webResearch.prompt: Please research a topic: confirm the topic if needed, gather public information online, and produce a document with key points and sources.

outline.title: Outline first, then write
outline.prompt: Based on the currently open document, draft an outline first and expand only after I confirm. If the document is empty, ask for the topic and audience.
outline.selectedTitle: Give this document a clear backbone

formalize.title: Make the tone more formal
formalize.prompt: Based on the currently open document, make the tone more formal and the structure clearer while preserving sections I already approved. Summarize the main edits afterward.
formalize.selectedTitle: Turn this into a polished formal draft

actionItems.title: Extract action items
actionItems.prompt: Based on the currently open document, extract actionable next steps (owner/due date can be blank) and append them as an Action items section.
actionItems.selectedTitle: Turn the document's next steps into action

summary.title: Condense into a one-page brief
summary.prompt: Based on the currently open document, produce a one-page brief with key conclusions, data, and next steps.
summary.selectedTitle: Distill the key points into a shareable brief

design.title: Design the table schema
design.prompt: Based on the currently open table, design or refine the field schema. If it is empty, propose fields first and write them after confirmation.
design.selectedTitle: Bring this table's structure into focus

stats.title: Run category stats
stats.prompt: Based on the currently open table, aggregate counts by a suitable category field and explain the results. Tell me what is missing if the data is insufficient.
stats.selectedTitle: Find the conclusions hiding in this table

insights.title: Find anomalies and trends
insights.prompt: Based on the currently open table, find anomalies and trends and write a concise conclusion. Create a short summary document if helpful.
insights.selectedTitle: See what the data is telling us

view.title: Add a board view
view.prompt: Based on the currently open table, design a board view for tracking progress and explain how each status should be used.
view.selectedTitle: Turn progress into a view at a glance

summarize.title: Summarize this page
summarize.prompt: Read the currently open web page and summarize key points, conclusions, and next steps into a short document.
summarize.selectedTitle: Pull the key points from this page

collectTable.title: Collect into a table
collectTable.prompt: From the currently open page, collect list or structured data into a table. Pilot a small sample first, then expand after fields look right.
collectTable.selectedTitle: Turn this page into usable data

toDoc.title: Turn the page into a doc
toDoc.prompt: Turn the currently open web page into a collaborative document, keep key facts and source links, and strip ads or navigation noise.
toDoc.selectedTitle: Shape this material into a shareable doc

compare.title: Build a competitor comparison
compare.prompt: Based on the currently open page and public information, produce a competitor comparison with key differences, pros, cons, and sources.

structure.title: Explain the project layout
structure.prompt: Read the current working directory / open code context and write a document explaining modules, entry points, and responsibilities.
structure.selectedTitle: Draw a map of this project

debug.title: Diagnose this error
debug.prompt: Using the open code or an error I paste, diagnose likely causes and propose a minimal fix. Explain impact before editing.
debug.outcome: Get a cause analysis and fix path
debug.selectedTitle: Trace this problem back to its root

smallChange.title: Make a small change
smallChange.prompt: In the current code context, make the smallest change that implements what I describe, then summarize the diff and how to verify it.
smallChange.outcome: Get a focused change and verification plan
smallChange.selectedTitle: Finish this with the smallest useful change

tests.title: Run checks and explain them
tests.prompt: Run the appropriate checks or tests for the current project, explain the results, and identify the issues to address first.
tests.outcome: Get test results and next steps
tests.selectedTitle: See whether this codebase is healthy
